decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is far from the firm's core offer and is only mentioned on the website, which limits the firm's ability to interpret results, but its maritime customer base and in-house R&D give it some related knowledge to build on.
The medical examination light builds on established lighting know-how and has its own page, so in-house R&D can assimilate feedback and improve it.
Explosion-proof industrial luminaires sit at the core of the firm's industrial lighting expertise and certified manufacturing, making them a strong product line to keep.
The designer task light is a relaunch of a popular, close-to-core product with its own page, so the firm understands its market well.
